Subject: GCP private offer — requesting pacing change + invoice cadence

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We reviewed the private offer and the initial burn schedule with our finance team — our production rollout is tracking slower than we expected. As a result, we need to ask for two modest changes before we can finalize the PO:

- Rephase the commit drawdown so the front-loaded portion is reduced in Q3 and pushed into Q4.
- Change invoice cadence to monthly invoices aligned to actual redemption rather than a single upfront invoice for Q3.

I've attached our June usage snapshot to show expected ramp (usage_report_Jun2026.csv). Can you confirm if Redwood can:

1) Extend the drawdown window by two months (so credits burn through December instead of October).
2) Support monthly invoicing tied to redeemed credits (we can accept a monthly reconciliation invoice).

We'd like to get a PO issued this month if we can align on terms.

Thanks,
Oliver Chen
Head of Cloud Ops
HelixData

Subject: Internal: Re: GCP private offer — proposed drawdown rephase for HelixData

Team — draft proposal below (numbers illustrative; final will match signed PO):

Current committed credits: $600k over 6 months (Jul–Dec 2026) with a $300k frontload in Jul–Aug.
Ben's proposed rephase:
- Reduce Jul–Aug frontload by 50% (move $150k into Nov–Dec).
- New schedule: Jul $60k, Aug $60k, Sep $80k, Oct $80k, Nov $160k, Dec $160k.

Invoice cadence: monthly reconciliation invoices issued on the 5th business day after month-end reflecting redeemed credits and any true-up. We can still issue an initial invoice for any non-refundable onboarding fee (if applicable), but credit redemption will be reconciled monthly.

GCP redemption/marketplace notes: we need to ensure the marketplace redemption window supports the shifted months; if GCP requires end-of-quarter consolidation for co-sell credits, we should flag this. Also recommend a clause allowing a one-time small credit carry-forward if usage is lower than forecast in Jul/Aug.

I'm attaching a simple XLSX with the proposed drawdown schedule and invoice dates (proposed_drawdown_schedule_helix.xlsx). If this looks acceptable we can convert into a PO addendum.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_drawdown_schedule_helix.xlsx (schedule + invoice dates)

Ben — schedule looks reasonable. A couple notes from marketplace ops:

1) GCP redemption window: GCP processes private offer redemptions nightly but finalizes monthly. To ensure Helix's monthly reconciliation matches what GCP reports, we should use the month-end redemption snapshot and then issue our invoice on the 5th business day (as Ben suggested). That avoids mismatch between what we invoice and what GCP will count.

2) Co-sell credit timing: if Helix expects co-sell incentive recognition, the partner rebate typically follows GCP's payout schedule (which can lag by 30–60 days). We can include language that co-sell credit recognition is subject to GCP payout timing and that Redwood will pass through any applicable partner credit info.

3) HubSpot & Docs: I'll add the schedule as an attachment to the HubSpot deal (HLX-45321) and prepare a DocuSign addendum template that mirrors the schedule and monthly invoice cadence.

LGTM aside from confirming Helix's PO template.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
